name: Name
title: Title
irreversible: This action cannot be undone. The selected rows will be removed from the storefront.
testimonialSubtitle: Curated quotes for marketing surfaces. These are editorial — real purchase reviews live under Transactions.
avatarCaption: Optional. Shown beside the quote on the storefront.
bodySectionsHint: Separate paragraphs with a blank line. A heading is optional per section.
heading: Heading
headingPlaceholder: Optional — leave blank for an intro paragraph
sectionPlaceholder: Write the section here. Leave a blank line between paragraphs.
bannerSubtitle: Hero slides on the storefront homepage. A banner whose image is missing is hidden rather than shown broken.
bannerImageReplace: Upload to replace the current image.
bannerImageRequiredCaption: Required — the storefront hides a banner with no image.
articleTitlePlaceholder: e.g. Cara Top Up Diamond Lebih Hemat
badgeLabelPlaceholder: Optional — defaults to the category name
badgeLabelHint: Set this only when the badge should differ from the category, e.g. a PUBG article filed under Lainnya.
author: Author
excerptPlaceholder: Short summary shown on the card. Max 300 characters.
articleCategorySubtitle: Categories are the filter pills on the storefront's news page. The key is what the URL and pill match on.
keyHint: Changing this on an existing category breaks any link already pointing at it.
pageSubtitle: Static pages such as the privacy policy. The slug is the URL the storefront reads it by.
introPlaceholder: Opening paragraphs, before the first heading. Separate with a blank line.
announcementSubtitle: Notices shown across the storefront. Only active announcements are published.
announcementPlaceholder: e.g. Server maintenance terjadwal pada hari Minggu...
faqSubtitle: Questions appear on the storefront's help page in the order set below, filtered by language.
question: Question
questionPlaceholder: e.g. Berapa lama proses top up berlangsung?
categoryDeleteBlocked: Failed to delete. Categories with articles cannot be removed.
faqPageSubtitle: Questions and answers shown on the storefront's help page, per language.
bannersSubtitle: Hero slides shown on the storefront homepage. A banner with no image is hidden automatically.
pagesSubtitle: Static pages such as the privacy policy, terms and refund policy.
articleIrreversible: This action cannot be undone. The selected content will be removed from the storefront.
testimonialsSubtitle: Curated customer quotes for marketing surfaces. Separate from real purchase reviews.
articleCategoriesSubtitle: The category pills the storefront filters articles by. The key is the stable identifier.
